name: Haboro (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Haboro town emblem in white: two broken concentric rings enclosing a stylised character above a five-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Haboro, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 August 1935.

features.role: Haboro town emblem — two broken concentric rings enclosing a stylised character above a five-pointed star
